releaseDetails.title: University administrator audit logs
releaseDetails.summary: AWU administrators can now investigate the newest business-scoped application activity from a native dashboard page.

sections.heading: Governance and accountability
sections.summary: The audit view uses JDD as the authoritative cross-application event store.

items.title: Tenant-safe access
items.description: The authenticated session fixes the university business, application and ERPNext instance scope.

items.title: Readable grouped columns
items.description: Actor, activity, runtime and result details are compact without losing investigation context.

sections.heading: Investigation tools
sections.summary: Administrators can work efficiently through large histories.

items.title: Newest-first records
items.description: Recent events are shown first with server-side pagination.

items.title: URL-backed filters
items.description: Search, category, outcome, page and page size can be bookmarked and revisited.

callout.title: JDD update required
callout.description: Deploy the matching JDD runtime endpoint before opening Audit Logs.
